projects.name: Neural Data Formats and Integrity
projects.problem: Make vendor recordings readable and check what changes during conversion.
projects.tools: Python, NumPy, Neo, SpikeInterface, Neuralynx CSC, DarkHorse MED

bullets.text: Adapted a Neo-backed MED reader to skip corrupt parity channels whose metadata caused standard readers to abort, allowing processing without modifying source recordings.

Evaluated signal fidelity across 20 million samples on one channel (32 kHz; 625 s), comparing original CSC and compressed MED recordings. Measured a maximum amplitude difference of 0.5 uV, with exact agreement after whole-microvolt source rounding.

projects.name: Neural Acquisition and Experimental Synchronization
projects.problem: Connect neural recordings to the experimental events needed to interpret them.
projects.tools: Python, Intan RHD/RHX, PsychoPy, SpikeInterface, Kilosort4

bullets.text: Built Python workflows for processing Intan recordings through SpikeInterface, including probe mapping, channel checks, spike sorting, waveform extraction, and quality metrics.
Developed synchronization software to align PsychoPy behavioral events with RHX recordings, using matched event labels and affine clock fitting to characterize drift between recording systems.

projects.name: Debugging Agent-Generated Software
projects.problem: Find and fix a slow CLI operation introduced during Codex-assisted development.
projects.tools: Python, Codex, timing instrumentation, content-based caching, regression tests

bullets.text: Investigated a performance regression in Hosaka, a command-line software platform, where agent-generated schema validation made listing seven records take approximately ten seconds.
Used execution timing logs to identify repeated validation as the bottleneck, then introduced content-based caching and regression tests to preserve checks for changed or invalid schemas.

med-adapter.verification: Commit-pinned source inspected; no recording or hardware rerun.
med-adapter.measurement_definition: Reader implementation and metadata handling, not a throughput or fidelity benchmark.
med-adapter.test_conditions: MED sessions with channel-name/directory mismatches; Neo MedRawIO and SpikeInterface NeoBaseRecordingExtractor.
med-adapter.verified_result: Adapter deactivates malformed channels before header parsing, exposes a serializable recording, selects sampling-rate streams, and preserves channel gains.
med-adapter.limitations: Source describes malformed parity-channel metadata causing native reader aborts. This is an adapter around an existing MED reader, not a compression implementation. No independent session-level test was run in this review.

neuralynx-repair.verification: Owner approved the high-level implementation description; public source and repair outputs were not supplied.
neuralynx-repair.measurement_definition: Validation and repair functionality, not a count of repaired files or a completeness benchmark.
neuralynx-repair.test_conditions: Neuralynx recordings rejected by downstream readers because of sample-count inconsistencies or missing recording-end metadata.
neuralynx-repair.verified_result: Owner developed validation and repair utilities for metadata problems that prevented downstream conversion.
neuralynx-repair.limitations: Implementation is owner-reported. No private code, recordings, repair logs, or inferred changes to signal samples are published.

sources.location: Code cells 0-2 (zero-based), including saved stdout and execute_result

dhn-fidelity.verification: Code and archived outputs cross-checked; raw source data unavailable for an independent rerun.
dhn-fidelity.measurement_definition: Elementwise CSC-minus-MED difference in microvolts; maximum absolute difference and nonzero count, before and after numpy.round of CSC.
dhn-fidelity.test_conditions: First 20,000,000 frames of one channel at 32,000 samples/s; MED contigua concatenated; physical-unit scaling.
dhn-fidelity.verified_result: 19,951,989 nonzero differences; maximum absolute error 0.5 uV. After whole-microvolt source rounding: zero mismatches. Compared duration is 625 s, derived as frames / sample rate.
dhn-fidelity.limitations: Not bit-exact relative to unrounded source. Mean error, compression ratio, file-size reduction, and encoder lossless/lossy settings are not established by these outputs. Do not generalize to complete sessions or other configurations.

visual.title: Sample-level fidelity (archived aggregates only)
visual.caption: One channel; 20,000,000 samples at 32,000 samples/s (625 s). Whole-uV rounding removes the observed differences; unrounded conversion is not bit-exact. No trace or error distribution is available.

sources.location: Code cells 0-5 (zero-based), especially saved cell 5 output

dhn-spike-control.verification: Archived code/output agreement inspected; no raw-data rerun or new sorting performed.
dhn-spike-control.measurement_definition: Exact intersection of the first sorted unit's spike-frame arrays; Jaccard = intersection / union with zero frame tolerance.
dhn-spike-control.test_conditions: Same 20-million-frame single-channel slice; both inputs scaled to uV and rounded to int32; canonical arrays asserted equal. Bandpass 300-6000 Hz; local whitening seed 0; MountainSort5 scheme 2 with internal filter/whiten disabled.
dhn-spike-control.verified_result: 35,587 CSC spikes and 35,587 MED spikes; 35,587 exact frame matches; no source-only events; exact Jaccard 1.0.
dhn-spike-control.limitations: Controlled consistency of equal rounded inputs, not proof of unrounded fidelity, biological unit correctness, all-unit conservation, real-time performance, or algorithm authorship.

visual.title: Exact spike-frame intersection
visual.caption: One compared unit, zero-frame tolerance. Identically rounded input arrays establish controlled sorting consistency, not fidelity of unrounded recordings or all-unit conservation.

intan-workflow.verification: Source inspected; acquisition hardware and source recordings not rerun.
intan-workflow.measurement_definition: Implementation evidence, not a timing or channel-yield measurement.
intan-workflow.test_conditions: Intan RHD input; explicit probe/contact-count guard; SpikeInterface and Kilosort4.
intan-workflow.verified_result: Reader, probe mapping, filtering, sorting, waveform extraction, and quality-metric computation are implemented.
intan-workflow.limitations: Public evidence covers file processing. The timing implementation is private; no public timing logs or bench-quality report were available.

hosaka-debugging.verification: Owner approved the debugging account; private implementation and test output were not independently inspected.
hosaka-debugging.measurement_definition: Owner-reported approximate elapsed time for listing seven records before the fix; profiling, caching, and regression-test approach. No before/after speedup ratio claimed.
hosaka-debugging.test_conditions: Owner reports a seven-record Hosaka listing took approximately ten seconds during Codex-assisted development; repeated schema validation identified with execution timing logs.
hosaka-debugging.verified_result: Owner introduced content-based caching and regression tests to avoid redundant validation while preserving checks for changed or invalid schemas.
hosaka-debugging.limitations: Approximate pre-fix timing and test behavior are owner-reported from the supplied revision brief. No public source revision, timing logs, or independently rerun regression results are published; no post-fix duration or measured speedup is inferred.

narrative-methods.verification: Owner approved publication of methods only; local alignment, binning, smoothing, and candidate-screening source inspected. No public source revision or recording rerun.
narrative-methods.measurement_definition: Implementation description only; no participant count, effect size, response significance, or semantic-selectivity measurement.
narrative-methods.test_conditions: Sorted single-unit timestamps aligned to Neuralynx narrative-onset events; per-presentation rasters, binned/smoothed rates, and preceding-interval comparisons.
narrative-methods.verified_result: Python methods implement event alignment and peri-stimulus analysis. Repeatable response observations are owner-reported, not publicly verified findings.
narrative-methods.limitations: Code and recordings are not published. Exploratory interval selection is not held-out inference; preceding-story activity can contaminate baseline intervals. Restricted narrative vocabulary cannot establish semantic tuning. Adaptive human stimulus selection remains proposed.

systems-methods.verification: Owner approved publication of responsibilities only; organizational records and model results were not supplied.
systems-methods.measurement_definition: Professional responsibilities, not a dataset-size, reliability, prediction, or causal-effect measurement.
systems-methods.test_conditions: Multi-site production IT and longitudinal service-utilization research support at First Step Communities. Existing candidate-provided title and dates retained, not independently verified.
systems-methods.verified_result: Owner reports network routing and VLAN segmentation, Microsoft 365/Exchange Online administration, camera/recording infrastructure, operational troubleshooting, and service-data research support.
systems-methods.limitations: No service-record, enrollment, or identifier counts published. Housing-outcome prediction and causal inference remain research development efforts; no trained-model performance or intervention effect claimed.
